header: Paid extras on top of a plan
subheader: The same list as rows or as a card grid
lead: What the add-on is, what it costs, and one line on what it does. The variant changes the surface and nothing else.
note: The note carries the terms shared by every extra — how they are billed, and what happens when one is switched off.

addons.title: The name is a heading
addons.text: Each extra is an item of the band, so it takes the third heading level.

addons.title: The price keeps its own column
addons.text: Pinned to the end edge in the list variant, so the figures read straight down.

addons.title: One line says what it does
addons.text: Any more than that and the row stops being scannable.

addons.title: Cards stretch to their row
addons.text: So the prices land on one optical line whatever the copy does below them.
